title: Final Energy Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The final expression for the ground state energy must be correctly stated as (3/2) hbar omega - (3 lambda^2)/(2m omega^2).

title: Perturbation Method
description: Important Criteria: The use of the perturbation method for degenerate states must be correctly applied, including the diagonalization of the perturbation Hamiltonian.

title: Matrix Elements
description: Important Criteria: The calculation of matrix elements for the perturbation must be correctly derived and presented.

title: Degeneracy Consideration
description: Important Criteria: The explanation of the two-fold degeneracy of the ground state must be clearly articulated.

title: Sign and Factor Checks
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common errors such as sign mistakes or missing factors in the perturbation calculations must be avoided.

title: Use of Quantum Numbers
description: Optional Criteria: The correct identification and use of quantum numbers (n_x, n_y, n_z) in the context of the problem should be included.

title: Energy Level Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The calculation of the unperturbed energy levels E^(0) must be correctly stated and utilized in the perturbation process.

title: Perturbation Terms
description: Optional Criteria: The inclusion of all relevant perturbation terms and their contributions to the energy shift should be discussed.
